entries.title: Job 21:1
segments: Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 21:2
segments: Hear diligently my speech; And let this be your consolations.

entries.title: Job 21:3
segments: Suffer me, and I also will speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

entries.title: Job 21:4
segments: As for me, is my complaint to man? And why should I not be impatient?

entries.title: Job 21:5
segments: Mark me, and be astonished,  And lay your hand upon your mouth.

entries.title: Job 21:6
segments: Even when I remember I am troubled, And horror taketh hold on my flesh.

entries.title: Job 21:7
segments: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?

entries.title: Job 21:8
segments: Their seed is established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.

entries.title: Job 21:9
segments: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

entries.title: Job 21:10
segments: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

entries.title: Job 21:11
segments: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

entries.title: Job 21:12
segments: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

entries.title: Job 21:13
segments: They spend their days in prosperity, And in a moment they go down to Sheol.

entries.title: Job 21:14
segments: And they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

entries.title: Job 21:15
segments: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

entries.title: Job 21:16
segments: Lo, their prosperity is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

entries.title: Job 21:17
segments: How oft is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out? That their calamity cometh upon them? That [God] distributeth sorrows in his anger?

entries.title: Job 21:18
segments: That they are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away?

entries.title: Job 21:19
segments: [Ye say], God layeth up his iniquity for his children. Let him recompense it unto himself, that he may know it:

entries.title: Job 21:20
segments: Let his own eyes see his destruction, And let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 21:21
segments: For what careth he for his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off?

entries.title: Job 21:22
segments: Shall any teach God knowledge, Seeing he judgeth those that are high?

entries.title: Job 21:23
segments: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet:

entries.title: Job 21:24
segments: His pails are full of milk, And the marrow of his bones is moistened.

entries.title: Job 21:25
segments: And another dieth in bitterness of soul, And never tasteth of good.

entries.title: Job 21:26
segments: They lie down alike in the dust, And the worm covereth them.

entries.title: Job 21:27
segments: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices wherewith ye would wrong me.

entries.title: Job 21:28
segments: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where is the tent wherein the wicked dwelt?

entries.title: Job 21:29
segments: Have ye not asked wayfaring men? And do ye not know their evidences,

entries.title: Job 21:30
segments: That the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity? That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

entries.title: Job 21:31
segments: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

entries.title: Job 21:32
segments: Yet shall he be borne to the grave, And men shall keep watch over the tomb.

entries.title: Job 21:33
segments: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And all men shall draw after him, As there were innumerable before him.

entries.title: Job 21:34
segments: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth [only] falsehood?
